caption: The video showcases a black bowl holding a reddish-brown liquid set against a deep black background. Floating in the center is a fluffy, coral-like mass marked by distinct patches of orange, blue, green, yellow, and pale pink-white. The structure remains broadly stable throughout, its feathery tendrils hanging in a consistent curtain above the surrounding liquid. The colored regions keep their positions, with the blue and yellow areas retaining their breadth while the white core stays dense and voluminous. Small pale specks cling to the inner rim of the bowl, unchanged as the central formation rests. The silhouette holds a relatively compact cluster shape, showing only faint shifts along the soft edges of the tendrils. The mass remains much the same at the end as at the start, neither sprawling nor receding.
